latin: Necessarium est tenere secundum Auenroem quod forma generis sit realiter alia a forma speciei, nec oppositum stat cum principiis doctrinae suae.
translation: It is necessary to hold, following Averroes, that the form of the genus is really other than the form of the species; nor does the contrary stand with the principles of his teaching.
